full_judgment: 13. The High Court Division held that, the Writ Petition is maintainable even within the limited scope set out in the case of Bangladesh and others Vs Santosh Kumar Saha and others. Along with the plea of enforcement of their fundamental rights, the writ petitioners have also argued that purely the questions of law, as well as the questions of interpretation of the Constitution and statutes being involved in Writ Petition, the adverse plea of alternative remedy, is not entertainable therein inasmuch as the alternative remedy before the Administrative Tribunal being already barred by limitation has become impossible to avail or the same and accordingly, relief by way of Writ Petition is competent.
